name: Layout Roulette
hook: Pick between two cursed floorplans before the load-bearing wall snaps
tagline: A sweaty interior designer shifts walls back and forth on a 3D blueprint as the toilet moves into the pantry and the shower wraps around the stove. Cashing out locks the deed on a mildly livable duplex and snaps tape measure in triumph. Crashing collapses the drywall stack into a dusty heap of broken ceramic tiles and open plumbing.
